name: Oscar Brain
source:
Suspicious as he looks, he is one of the heroes who led the past war to victory.
Having distinguished experiences, currently he is the principle of Salem School which is oriented towards noble children.
He also helped Shelly's parents after the decline of Linestad family.

[Translated from [url=http://products.web-giga.com/clarias/]official website[/url]]
